name: Homer
hook: Two epics, one war, one long voyage home — Homer is Jeopardy's ancient default.

facts.label: the epic poet
facts.statement: Homer is the ancient Greek epic poet, mocked in antiquity by the Battle of the Frogs and the Mice and later painted by Rembrandt with Aristotle.
associations: Battle of the Frogs and the Mice

facts.label: the Iliad
facts.statement: The Iliad is the Trojan War epic: Achilles, the Greeks' greatest warrior, kills Hector, and the poem ends with Hector's funeral.

facts.label: the Odyssey
facts.statement: The Odyssey follows Odysseus home to Ithaca after a 10-year voyage; Penelope sets a bow contest, and only his dog Argus knows him at first.

facts.label: Troy
facts.statement: Troy, also called Ilium, was excavated by Heinrich Schliemann in the 1870s using descriptions from the Iliad.

facts.label: Alexander the Great
facts.statement: Alexander the Great carried a copy of the Iliad with him in a special gold casket while conquering Asia.

facts.label: Ulysses
facts.statement: Ulysses is the Latin name for Odysseus — the hero of Pope's translation, and the title Joyce gave his Dublin novel.
